description.value: The Caledonia Nordic Ski Club is a non-profit outdoor recreation facility founded in 1957, located about 15 minutes from downtown Prince George on the unceded lands of the Lheidli T'enneh. It offers kilometres of maintained trails for nordic skiing, snowshoeing, single-track mountain biking, hiking, and disc golf across beginner to advanced terrain. In summer it hosts youth mountain bike camps and sessions, making it a notable trail destination for cyclists visiting the Prince George area.
